passive.name: Daylight's Augury
passive.text: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG increased by **12/15/18/21/24%**. After a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst hits an opponent, 1 stack of Ashen Nightstar will be gained for 12s. When 1/2/3/4 stacks of Ashen Nightstar are present, ATK is increased by **10/20/30/48% | 12.5/25/37.5/60% | 15/30/45/72% | 17.5/35/52.5/84% | 20/40/60/96%**. The stack of Ashen Nightstar created by the Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst will be counted independently of the others.

passive.name: The Cleansing Form
passive.text: HP is increased by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When there are opponents nearby, the DMG dealt by the wielder of this weapon is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%**. This will take effect whether the character is on-field or not.

passive.name: Echoing Ballad
passive.text: Increases CRIT DMG by **20/25/30/35/40%**. Hits have a **60/70/80/90/100%** chance to inflict a small AoE attack, dealing 125% Physical ATK DMG. Can only occur once every **4/3.5/3/2.5/2**s.

passive.name: Arrowless Song
passive.text: Increases Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG by **24/30/36/42/48%**.

skillPriority: Normal Attack > Elemental Skill > Elemental Burst

entries.name: Bolts of Downfall
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

**Charged Attack**
Performs a more precise **Aimed Shot** with increased DMG.
While aiming, the dark lightning spirits of Immernachtreich shall heed the call of their Prinzessin and indwell the enchanted arrowhead. When fully indwelt, the Rachsüchtig Blitz shall deal immense **Electro DMG**.

**Plunging Attack**
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Nightrider
entries.text:
Summons Oz. The night raven forged of darkness and lightning descends upon the land, dealing **Electro DMG** in a small AoE.
For the ability's duration, Oz will continuously attack nearby opponents with **Freikugel**.

Hold to adjust the location Oz will be summoned to.
Press again any time during the ability's duration to once again summon him to Fischl's side.

"My time is most precious, and I shall not waste it on the likes of you... Go, Oz, fall upon them, and bring down upon them your Rachsüchtig Blitz, that which tears open the long night."
—Flowers for Princess Fischl (IV): Farewell Frau Welt

entries.name: Midnight Phantasmagoria
entries.text:
Summons Oz to spread his twin wings of twilight and defend Fischl.
Has the following properties during the ability's duration:
·Fischl takes on Oz's form, greatly increasing her Movement Speed.
·Strikes nearby opponents with lightning, dealing **Electro DMG** to opponents she comes into contact with. Each opponent can only be struck once.
·Once this ability's effects end, Oz will remain on the battlefield and attack his Prinzessin's foes. If Oz is already on the field, then this will reset the duration of his presence.

"...In the hordes of beasts that follow the cursed blood, only Prince Nachtraben, who bore witness to the extinction of a thousand worlds, knows her true greatness. Thus the night wings he spreads are his eternal promise to protect Her Royal Highness."
—Flowers for Princess Fischl (I): End Time Zersetzung

entries.name: Stellar Predator
entries.text: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing **AoE Electro DMG** equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.

entries.name: Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex
entries.text: If your current active character triggers an **Electro-related Elemental Reaction** when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals **Electro DMG** equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.

entries.name: Mein Hausgarten
entries.text: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

entries.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Phantasmal Nocturne
entries.text:
After completing **Witch's Homework: Of the Unexpected**, Fischl will become a **Hexerei** character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the **Hexerei: Secret Rite** effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

**Hexerei: Secret Rite**
Hark, Prince Nachtraben, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, he who has witnessed the fall of countless worlds. Sing now the starry septet for your sovereign, for this is the moment of deepest sin, when the gathered souls at the end of causality shatter the darkness of fate.
Additionally, when Oz is on the field, party members will gain additional buff effects:
· After a nearby party member triggers an Overloaded reaction, Fischl and other nearby active party members have their ATK increased by 22.5% for 10s.
· After a nearby party member triggers an Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reaction, Fischl and other nearby active party members have their Elemental Mastery increased by 90 for 10s.

entries.name: Gaze of the Deep
entries.text: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.

entries.name: Devourer of All Sins
entries.text: When **Nightrider** is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.

entries.name: Wings of Nightmare
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Nightrider** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
entries.text:
When **Midnight Phantasmagoria** is used, it deals 222% of ATK as **Electro DMG** to surrounding opponents.
When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

entries.name: Against the Fleeing Light
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Midnight Phantasmagoria** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Evernight Raven
entries.text: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as **Electro DMG**.
